# Resizable

Panels people resize by dragging the line between them.

:label[Left out of Brand expressive]{tone="warning"} Resizable is for desktop tools and not phones. Visitors come from social posts on their phones, and Brand expressive avoids tools people use for hours. Use instead: [Card](./card)

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Desktop tools where people choose how much space each panel gets.
- **Not when:** Phones, or layouts with one obvious shape.

Instead:

- [Sidebar](./sidebar.md): Fixed app navigation.

<a class="odv-anatref" href="./resizable/anatomy"><span class="odv-anatref-b"><b>Anatomy reference</b><span>Every part of the resizable panels, the job it does, and the decisions behind it. 4 parts.</span></span><span class="odv-anatref-go" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The handle can be focused and moved with arrow keys. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add resizable
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Resizable reads 11 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Resizable's tokens to change Resizable alone.
